goal: Lokale und CI-Vorprüfung auf eine gemeinsame Preflight-Logik zusammenführen, damit Fortschrittsdrift, ungültige Gate-Profile und Routingfehler vor teuren Gates erkannt werden.

guide_delta.summary: I152 extrahiert Kontext-, Manifest- und Gate-Routing-Prüfung in ein gemeinsames Preflight-Skript, das lokal und im PR-Router identisch verwendet wird.

direct_dependencies: I149 exposed progress drift and invalid gate-profile loops
existing manifest and fast-context validators remain authoritative
tests_required: compile preflight script and governance test
shared route contract returns expected targeted/governance/foundation gates
frozen-core write without deep gate fails closed
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because runtime product code is unchanged
Chromium tests because UI is unchanged
storage tests because database code is unchanged
risks: CI and local preflight could diverge if workflow retains duplicate routing logic
preflight must fail closed on protected paths and profile downgrades
preflight must not weaken existing scope validation
non_changes: changed-file scope validation remains a separate mandatory step
expected_side_effects: local and CI gate routing use the same Python implementation
invalid manifest/profile combinations fail before targeted or foundation gates
progress drift fails before expensive test jobs
workflow YAML becomes smaller and easier to audit
